preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawalBNB() to drain all BNB/ETH from the contract to your address. Additionally, you can call withdrawalToken() to steal any ERC20 tokens held by the contract, mint() to create unlimited tokens for yourself, or set fees to 100% to rug pull liquidity providers.
